decisions.reason: The accelerator is featured on the home page and signals the firm's announced circular-economy leadership, so this public commitment and its low running cost favor keeping it despite uncertain direct returns.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder keeps its own dedicated page and embodies the low-emission direction the firm has announced, so management will attribute slow uptake to market development time and persist.

The infectious waste decontamination plant sits close to the core machinery business, draws on existing manufacturing investment and is shown prominently on the home page, making continuation the natural choice.
